blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Coquitlam acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for a detached house in Coquitlam was $1,584,400 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Coquitlam houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026
Fewer than 3 houses with acreage sold in Coquitlam, too few to describe.
When so few sell, one sale is the whole picture, so this page does not quote a typical price. Ask Jared for the recent sales near the address you are looking at.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Coquitlam: the detached houses benchmark was $1,584,400 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 6.6%; over three months it fell 3.9%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.0%; over 5 years it was little changed (-0.6%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 31.7%.
Detached houses against other home types in Coquitlam

Coquitlam: the detached houses benchmark of $1,584,400 sits $607,800 above the townhomes benchmark of $976,600 (162% of it) and $944,300 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $640,100 (248% of it).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
